description: This dataset provides the archetype definitions, operating schedules and literature sources used to model the energy use of Nigerian residential dwellings from the bottom up for scenario analysis. It was published on Zenodo on 18 April 2024 by Chibuikem Nwagwu, Şahin Akın and Edgar Hertwich of the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, for the paper 'Bottom-Up Archetype-based Modelling of Nigerian Residential Dwellings for Scenario Analysis'. One sheet gives the semantic, geometric and technical parameters of each dwelling archetype used to generate energy models; one gives occupancy and operation schedules compiled from the literature and refined by expert consensus, formatted for DesignBuilder; and one lists the literature sources. Coverage is Nigeria's residential typologies. Access: three Excel files, open download. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: parameters come from literature and expert judgement, not a national survey. Simulation uses are national housing energy and emissions scenarios, cooling demand under climate change and efficiency policy analysis. Related records: archetypal and the Kigali building typology.
